depicts: A first-person game screenshot with orange walls and tiled floor, an overlaid green-and-grey cheat menu with colour wheels, outlined player figures and a held pistol.
text_readable: Readable: "COLORS", "CONFIGS", "ESP Color", "Chams Color", "Glow Color", "$800", "BOT Perry (RADIO): Enemy spotted.", "Ron", "Calvin". Small labels like "Glock18" and "77HP" are tiny and hard to read.
composition: Menu panel spans lower left and centre; radar at upper left; two outlined figures right of centre; pistol at lower right. Black bars run down the left and right edges.
tone_and_contrast: Saturated orange scene with dark grey menu panel, green outlines and text, and multicolour wheels. Menu separates well from the orange; small green text is on grey.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Video-frame softness and compression noise around text and edges; overlapping ghosted outlines behind the menu. Black pillarbox bars are baked in on both sides. HUD elements and radar are visible.
scan_first_read: A game screen with a colourful settings menu overlay on an orange scene.
